name: PredictLeads
description: PredictLeads provides B2B company intelligence and buying signals: hiring, news events, technology use, funding and similar companies.

events.d: Get firmographic details of a company by its domain or PredictLeads ID.
Stop following a company by its domain or PredictLeads ID.
Follow a company by domain to receive its new signals through webhooks.
Get the companies you follow, with their custom identifiers.
Get a company's job openings, filtered by status, dates, location or category.
Get a company's news events, filtered by category, location or date.
Get the technologies a company uses, filtered by first or last seen date.
Retrieve a company's funding rounds and financing events; filter by date range and paginate results.
Get companies similar to a chosen company, with reasons for the closest matches.
